hypothesis: Eine einzige feste ATR-basierte Trailing-Exit-Regel als Lifecycle-Layer kann die robuste Risikoqualität des festen 50/50-Kandidaten verbessern, ohne Rendite- oder Evidence-Gates zu verschlechtern.

mechanism.baseline: fixed 50/50 SMA 50/200 inverse-volatility trend sleeve + 12-1 cross-sectional Top-2 + 10% portfolio volatility budget
mechanism.intervention: apply one fixed trailing exit only to the trend sleeve; highest close since entry minus 3x ATR20
mechanism.atr_definition: simple average true range over the latest 20 sessions, using the prior session close in each true-range calculation
mechanism.entry_rule: asset enters only when the unchanged monthly baseline trend sleeve has a positive allocation
mechanism.exit_rule: close(t) below highest_close_since_entry - 3*ATR20 triggers flat position
mechanism.reentry_rule: after a stop, remain flat until the next monthly baseline rebalance; positive baseline allocation re-enters and resets highest close
mechanism.weight_policy: remaining trend weights are not renormalized after an exit
